message.content: During the conversation, MalfurionStormrage suggests setting up a little gathering once the flowers are settled in the garden. He proposes that this could be a "nice way to enjoy the garden together." Malfurion also emphasizes the importance of creating a "wonderful place for everyone to gather and enjoy nature together." Furthermore, he suggests that a gathering could be an excellent opportunity to have snacks and drinks outside, allowing everyone to chill out and appreciate the newly blooming flowers. The idea of a community event is further supported by Turalyon, who mentions that it could be a "good chance to hang out," and RexxarRemar adds that it would be "nice to relax there and enjoy the garden after all the hard work." Overall, Malfurion’s suggestion revolves around creating a communal gathering space to celebrate the completion of the garden renovation project.
